description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of a diffusion-based text generation model across five training steps (100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000), measured using three variants of the ROUGE metric: ROUGE-1 (blue with diagonal stripes), ROUGE-2 (light green with dots), and ROUGE-L (orange with horizontal stripes). The horizontal axis, labeled “Step,” represents the number of training steps, while the vertical axis, unlabeled but scaled from 0 to approximately 45, indicates the ROUGE score values. At each step, the three ROUGE metrics are displayed as grouped bars. As training progresses, all three metrics show a clear upward trend: at Step 100, scores are 6.3 (ROUGE-1), 0.1 (ROUGE-2), and 3.0 (ROUGE-L); by Step 2000, they reach 41.2, 19.1, and 33.4 respectively. ROUGE-1 consistently achieves the highest score at every step, followed by ROUGE-L, while ROUGE-2 remains the lowest, indicating that unigram overlap is better captured than bigram or longest common subsequence overlap. The chart visually confirms that model performance improves with more training steps, with the most significant gains occurring between Step 500 and Step 1000.
